eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 37 · Grouping and Aggregating

code:
-- ERROR: can't use an aggregate in WHERE
SELECT Color, AVG(ListPrice) AS AveragePrice
FROM Production.Product
WHERE AVG(ListPrice) > 500
GROUP BY Color;
caption: WHERE runs BEFORE GROUP BY — the average doesn't exist yet.

code:
SELECT Color, AVG(ListPrice) AS AveragePrice
FROM Production.Product
GROUP BY Color
HAVING AVG(ListPrice) > 500;
caption: HAVING runs AFTER groups and their aggregates already exist.

code:
SELECT Color, AVG(ListPrice) AS AveragePrice
FROM Production.Product
WHERE Color IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Color
HAVING AVG(ListPrice) > 500;
caption: WHERE removes rows first; HAVING then filters the groups that remain.

subtitle: Stacking results from more than one query.
